_comment: PO pinned to an accounting month OTHER than their order_date month — e.g. a consignment tax invoice issued the month after the goods moved. The Expenses tab already takes every PO of the month regardless of status (pending POs are usually consignment: the invoice is real, the PO stays open so stock isn't double-counted), so an entry is only needed to move a PO across months. To drop a PO instead, use 08_config/po_exclude.json or the force-exclude button in the portal. An entry applies only when its `month` matches the report month.
